description: pytest plugin that detects N+1 queries and enforces query budgets for SQLAlchemy 2 (sync, async, FastAPI), with an opt-in PostgreSQL missing-index check.
rules: Install with pip install pytest-queryguard; the plugin registers itself, nothing to import or configure.
Fix a reported relationship N+1 by loading the relationship with the parent query, e.g. select(Order).options(joinedload(Order.customer)).
Use @pytest.mark.max_queries(n) or the pytest_queryguard.max_queries(n) context manager to set a query budget; budgets also catch write loops.
Exclude small lookup tables from the missing-index check with queryguard_index_ignore_tables or @pytest.mark.allow_missing_index instead of turning the check off.
The missing-index check needs PostgreSQL 16 or newer and a sync engine.
